title: DStv Prices in South Africa – Stream vs Satellite
description: Compare DStv Stream and satellite prices in rand with Mzansi Stream’s one-month and annual payments. See what you pay today and over 12 months.
h1: What DStv costs in South Africa, on stream and satellite
intro: A South African household with an internet connection can buy one month of DStv Stream Starter for R99. A single month of Mzansi Stream is R199. Mzansi’s lower monthly equivalent comes from paying R1,199 for a year in advance. If you are deciding what you can spend this payday, those are three different choices.

sections.h2: How much does each DStv package cost?
sections.h3: Monthly prices in rand, checked on 26 November 2026
paragraphs: These package prices were checked on 26 November 2026. Add only the extra services or equipment on your own quote.

The other R799 figure beside Premium is a 24-month decoder contract that includes the Access Fee. If you are comparing two R799 offers, write down which uses a decoder, what you already own and how long you would have to keep paying.

sections.h2: What would you pay today and over twelve months?
sections.h3: Compare the first payment with the annual total
paragraphs: At an unchanged R99 monthly price, twelve monthly payments for DStv Stream Starter come to R1,188. The Mzansi annual payment is R1,199, a difference of R11 over the year. You spend R99 today for one month of Starter, R199 for one month of Mzansi, or R1,199 today for the Mzansi annual plan. The annual Mzansi price divided by twelve is R99.92. These totals compare subscription cost. The services carry different programmes.

If your budget is R200 this month, both monthly options fit. If you are considering prepaying for a year, use the advertised 24-hour Mzansi trial on the television and connection you plan to use. Check the programmes that matter to you before deciding whether the larger payment makes sense.

sections.h2: Which extra costs belong in your decision?
sections.h3: Use costs your household will actually incur
paragraphs: Start with your latest statement. Add the subscription, any decoder or installation charge quoted to you, and any extra data you would buy specifically for streaming. If you already pay for uncapped home internet and will keep it whatever you choose, include only the extra cost you expect. A household watching on prepaid mobile data may reach a different conclusion using the same package prices.

title: DStv Open Time 2026: What Ends on 25 December?
description: Find out who gets extra live channels, what happens to Catch Up, and what your DStv package shows again on 26 December 2026.
h1: DStv Open Time 2026 and the channels that return to normal on 26 December
intro: If a channel you never subscribed to appeared on your South African decoder or DStv Stream account on 25 November, DStv Open Time may explain it. The offer opens extra live channels for eligible subscribers through 25 December 2026. The next day, 26 December, normal access returns to the package on the account.

sections.h2: Who gets the extra live channels?
sections.h3: Check the account and the package
paragraphs: DStv names four eligible packages in South Africa: Starter, Select, Sports and Movies & Series. The account must be fully paid up. DStv excludes EasyView. Both satellite and DStv Stream are included. Eligible customers receive the channels automatically and keep paying the normal charge for their own package.

If someone asks you to pay an unlock fee, first check the promotion on DStv’s own page linked below. You can also open your own DStv account to confirm the package and balance. There is no separate Open Time purchase or activation step.

sections.h2: Why can I watch a channel live but miss the replay?
sections.h3: Check the live schedule separately from Catch Up
paragraphs: Open Time covers live TV. Catch Up remains tied to your ordinary package. For example, if a film appears on a newly opened channel on Friday night, the promotion lets you watch the scheduled broadcast. Whether the film is in your personal Catch Up catalogue afterwards depends on the package you already pay for.

If the family wants one particular programme, check its live start time. If you usually watch later, open the programme’s Catch Up listing before changing your weekend plans. A familiar channel name in the live guide tells you little about which episodes will remain available later.

sections.h2: What happens if I change plans?
sections.h3: Make a decision using the channels you actually watched
paragraphs: DStv says customers who move to a lower package during Open Time no longer qualify for the full channel line-up. If you are considering a downgrade, check both your change date and how that change affects the current offer before confirming it.

Keep a short list during the promotion: which extra channel you used, which programme you watched and whether you watched it live. On 26 December, compare that list with your regular package. A temporary channel disappearing on that date is expected. If your contracted channels also disappear, check your account status and raise that separate issue with DStv.

title: DStv Nigeria: New Packages and Your Next Bill
description: See the November package prices in naira, why an old name may still appear in MyDStv, and what to check before your next payment.
h1: DStv Nigeria’s new packages and what to check before your next payment
intro: If MyDStv still shows an old package name, check the amount due and the channels on your decoder before making another payment. DStv Nigeria introduced four core packages on 5 November 2026. It says the change is happening in phases and that new channels can already be available while the previous package name is still displayed.

sections.h2: Which DStv package fits your household?
sections.h3: Compare the four monthly prices in naira
paragraphs: Starter is ₦6,000 per month, Select is ₦11,000, Sports is ₦21,000 and Premium is ₦44,500. Start with one programme or sport you regularly watch. DStv lists Africa Magic Showcase among the channels added with Select. Sports includes every Premier League and UEFA Champions League match according to the launch guide. Premium adds sports such as Formula 1, tennis and golf.

The step from Select to Sports is ₦10,000 each month. The step from Sports to Premium is ₦23,500. If the main reason for paying is a particular competition, check its coverage in the current Nigerian package listing. A price beside a familiar bouquet name in an older article can send you to the wrong tier.

sections.h2: Why does an old package name still appear?
sections.h3: Read the account and the decoder together
paragraphs: Write down four things before renewal: the package name displayed in MyDStv, the amount due, the next payment date shown on your account and the name of a channel you can actually open. Save the date of that check. During a phased change, those four details give customer support something more precise to investigate than a report that the new package has not arrived.

For example, if the account shows an old label and your decoder already opens a newly listed channel, check what your own account says is due. If the amount differs from what you authorised, ask DStv to explain the account entry before treating a generic price table as a bill.

sections.h2: Does migration mean buying a new decoder?
sections.h3: Keep the hardware question separate from renewal
paragraphs: DStv Nigeria says the package migration does not require a new decoder. A failed device is a separate technical issue. If an agent proposes a hardware purchase, ask which fault they have identified and check the offer with DStv. To question a renewal, use the official Nigerian account service with your four recorded details and the payment reference if you already paid.

title: DStv Ghana: Prices and Paying for Family
description: Compare Ghana’s packages in cedis and use the official payment options to renew a relative’s account. Check the recipient and amount before paying.
h1: DStv Ghana prices and how to renew a relative’s account
intro: If you pay for a parent or relative in Ghana, start with the name on the account and the amount DStv says is due. DStv Ghana allows people to pay for another subscriber and provides a way to verify the account before paying. The package price and the programmes the family can watch depend on the Ghanaian subscription.

sections.h2: Which Ghanaian package does the household need?
sections.h3: Start with a programme the family already watches
paragraphs: The four monthly packages introduced on 5 November 2026 are Starter at GH₵50, Select at GH₵100, Sports at GH₵250 and Ultimate at GH₵570. If your relative mainly wants Akwaaba Magic, DStv Ghana lists that channel in Starter. For a household following a team throughout the football season, check the coverage of its competition. Starter offers selected fixtures, while Sports lists every Premier League and UEFA Champions League match.

Ask which package the family already uses and which programme it wants to keep. If a relative only wants the current month renewed, confirm that first. A request to pay a bill and a request to change a package are separate decisions.

sections.h2: How can you pay for someone else?
sections.h3: Verify the recipient and balance before authorising
paragraphs: Use the official Ghana payment page below and open the self-service route from there. Enter the account details requested for the subscriber you intend to pay. Verify the account returned and the amount before you authorise the payment. If the details point to another relative or an old account, stop at the confirmation screen and have the account holder check the identifier.

You can make that check together on a call. Ask the person at home to read the identifier from their account rather than forwarding a payment link. Record which subscription the payment covers so that two relatives supporting the same household do not both renew it.

sections.h2: Which payment route should you use?
sections.h3: Keep the reference until the account updates
paragraphs: DStv Ghana lists MTN Mobile Money, bank options, self-service and in-person payment routes. Use whichever official option is available to you. A relative overseas should check the options offered for their payment method before assuming that a particular card or mobile wallet will work.

Keep the transaction reference, amount, date and account identifier. If your bank or wallet shows a completed payment and the DStv balance still looks wrong, give those details to DStv Ghana through its official contact channels before trying a second payment. A Mzansi Stream sales chat cannot reconcile a DStv account.

title: DStv Kenya: Find Your Match and Commentary
description: Check Kenyan prices, find the channel for a specific match and see where Swahili coverage is listed before choosing a DStv package.
h1: DStv Kenya packages for a particular match and commentary language
intro: Which package shows your match in Kenya, and will you hear Swahili commentary? The first answer starts with the local TV guide. The second depends on the feed scheduled for that fixture. DStv Kenya’s package guide describes the coverage of its sports channels, but a match carried somewhere in the package can have a different commentary option from the one you want.

sections.h2: Which package carries the fixture?
sections.h3: Look up both teams and the date in the Kenyan guide
paragraphs: Open DStv Kenya’s TV guide and search for the two teams. Check the date, kick-off time and full channel name. If the same teams appear twice, check whether the listing is live or a repeat. For an evening game played abroad, the Kenyan broadcast or replay may appear on a different calendar day.

Next compare the listed channel with the Kenyan package guide. Starter includes selected football on SuperSport KICKOFF. DStv describes Sports as covering every Premier League and UEFA Champions League match. That distinction matters if you are following one team each week: a selected match may suit you this weekend without meeting the same need next weekend.

sections.h2: Where is Swahili coverage listed?
sections.h3: Check the broadcast feed for this particular match
paragraphs: DStv lists SuperSport Swahili among the additional sports channels and describes a selection of matches and events on it. Look for the fixture under that feed. If the general listing confirms only the match and channel, leave the commentary language open until the local guide, broadcaster or programme information confirms it.

Take a practical example. Your family wants one Saturday fixture and would prefer Swahili. Write down the teams first. Then record the channel carrying the live game and whether SuperSport Swahili also lists it. Only after those checks does the package comparison tell you the relevant price.

sections.h2: How much is the monthly step between packages?
sections.h3: Compare the cost with the programmes you would gain
paragraphs: DStv Kenya lists Starter at KSh750 per month, Select at KSh1,500, Sports at KSh3,000 and Ultimate at KSh7,300 following the 5 November 2026 change. Moving from Select to Sports adds KSh1,500 a month. Moving from Sports to Ultimate adds KSh4,300. Starter already includes Maisha Magic Plus, which matters if local drama is the family’s main reason to subscribe.

Keep the match, date, channel, commentary confirmation and monthly price together. That short record is also what you need if the on-screen schedule changes and you want to ask DStv Kenya about one specific broadcast.

title: DStv Afrique : trouver le bon bouquet selon le pays
description: Choisissez le pays du foyer, vérifiez la devise et trouvez la fiche DStv locale. Comparez aussi les options en français avant de payer.
h1: DStv Afrique : quel bouquet pour le pays de votre foyer ?
intro: Vous êtes à Paris et vous aidez un parent à Brazzaville à choisir sa télévision. Le premier renseignement utile est la ville où se trouve son téléviseur. Une offre trouvée en français peut concerner le Ghana, et une grille en francs peut concerner un autre pays. Trois vérifications permettent de retrouver le bon abonnement avant d’envoyer de l’argent.

sections.h2: Dans quel pays la télévision sera-t-elle utilisée ?
sections.h3: Retrouver le portail du foyer
paragraphs: Pour un téléviseur à Brazzaville, partez du portail DStv de la République du Congo, identifié par le code pays CG. Kinshasa relève de la République démocratique du Congo. Si une recherche affiche seulement « Congo », vérifiez le nom complet du pays en haut ou en bas de la page. Un proche installé à l’étranger peut faire cette vérification avec vous.

Pour un compte existant, relevez la devise, le nom du bouquet et la prochaine échéance dans le compte du titulaire. Demandez la fiche nationale correspondant exactement à ces trois renseignements. Un prix communiqué dans une capture d’écran sans devise ni période de facturation laisse deux questions ouvertes avant le paiement.

sections.h2: Combien coûte le bouquet d’entrée ?
sections.h3: Trois repères mensuels vérifiés le 26 novembre 2026
paragraphs: Au Nigeria, DStv annonce Starter à 6 000 nairas, puis Select à 11 000, Sports à 21 000 et Premium à 44 500. Au Ghana, les quatre montants sont de 50, 100, 250 et 570 cedis. Le quatrième bouquet ghanéen s’appelle Ultimate. Au Kenya, comptez respectivement 750, 1 500, 3 000 et 7 300 shillings kényans, avec Ultimate au dernier palier.

Une conversion en euros peut aider la personne qui paie à établir son budget. Pour choisir ce que verra le foyer, ouvrez ensuite la liste locale et cherchez deux ou trois émissions par leur nom. Le même nom de bouquet dans deux pays ne suffit pas à établir que les programmes seront identiques.

sections.h2: Comment vérifier les programmes en français ?
sections.h3: Le nom de l’émission et la langue à l’écran
paragraphs: Si votre parent demande les informations en français, faites préciser la chaîne ou le journal. Pour un film, vérifiez aussi la piste audio ou les sous-titres proposés pour le titre. Au Ghana, DStv décrit French Plus comme un supplément à associer à un abonnement existant. Demandez le total avec ce supplément et vérifiez sa compatibilité avec le bouquet retenu. Cette fiche ghanéenne ne donne aucun prix pour Brazzaville.

title: SABC Without DStv: Free TV, Radio and SABC+
description: Find SABC’s own TV and radio services, see which SABC+ options are free or paid, and check which news and audio services work outside South Africa.
h1: How to watch SABC without a DStv subscription
intro: If the television you want is SABC News, or the radio station you miss is a South African one, start with SABC+. The broadcaster offers its own website and app. You can try the relevant channel directly before deciding whether an extra TV subscription would add anything. Your location and the particular programme matter, especially outside South Africa.

sections.h2: What can you watch in South Africa?
sections.h3: Find the channel or episode on SABC+
paragraphs: Open the SABC+ website in a browser. Use Live for a programme that is on now, Radio for a station, or Catchup and On Demand for something you missed. For a series, search for the title and open the episode you want. A trailer and an episode can share a name. Check the running time and the episode number before making any decision about payment.

SABC describes both a free offering and subscription options. Its FAQ says registration is free and provides access to free live TV channels, radio stations and a selection of programmes. Check the access message on your chosen title. If you have just installed the app on a television, trying the same title first on the broadcaster’s website can help establish whether it is available on your account.

sections.h2: Which services can you use overseas?
sections.h3: Answers for news listeners and radio audiences
paragraphs: SABC lists specific international services in its FAQ. They include SABC News, SABC Lehae, radio, podcasts, vodcasts and SABC News on demand. For example, someone in Manchester who missed a news bulletin can start in the news section. Someone in Perth who wants a familiar breakfast show can look for the station under Radio and check its South African broadcast time.

Keep that list handy if a relative recommends paying for an overseas package to hear a single radio station. Try the station directly from your current location. For a sports fixture, film or drama series, check that particular listing separately. The availability of the news stream says nothing about the local rights for a drama episode.

sections.h2: What if a programme refuses to play?
sections.h3: Work out whether to contact SABC or check another listing
paragraphs: Write down the programme, episode or match, the time you tried it, the country you were in and the words on the screen. An upgrade prompt, a territorial restriction and a spinning player describe different problems. If a listed international service fails, try its official web player and send the exact error through the support route in the SABC+ FAQ. That gives the broadcaster something specific to investigate.

title: DStv UK: What Happens to Your South African Account?
description: Moving from South Africa to the UK? Check DStv streaming limits, decide what to do with your home account and find the official cancellation route.
h1: Moving to the UK with a South African DStv account
intro: A DStv payment going through in South Africa does not give a television in the UK access to DStv Stream. DStv explains that its app offers viewing while travelling in African countries where DStv operates and has no streaming content in other countries. The practical decision before a move is what to do with the subscription for the household back home.

sections.h2: Can you keep watching on the same app in Britain?
sections.h3: Check the territory before buying equipment
paragraphs: Imagine moving from Durban to Birmingham with your tablet and an active subscription. The account may still need managing in South Africa. Its live channels and Catch Up do not become a UK television package. Downloading the app again or buying a new streaming stick will not create UK viewing rights. For a particular series or fixture, look up its title or competition with a broadcaster serving the UK.

If a child or parent stays in Durban, first ask what they actually watch on the decoder. Write down two or three regular programmes, the current package, the amount due and who handles the bill. That list lets the account holder compare the local options without disrupting a programme someone at home still relies on.

sections.h2: What should you do before the household leaves?
sections.h3: Find the products and the next payment date
paragraphs: Open the official DStv account yourself and select My Products. Check the package, next payment date and any separate product or bundle. If you have a fixed-term agreement or a DStv Internet deal, ask DStv how much closing it would cost and whether linked services would end. DStv specifically asks Internet contract holders to contact it directly. Save the answer with your account records.

If only one person is moving, decide with the people staying behind who will manage future bills. Keeping the South African subscription may suit a family still watching there. It will not provide the account holder with a UK live stream.

sections.h2: How do you schedule a disconnection?
sections.h3: Confirm the product and save the effective date
paragraphs: For ordinary package disconnection, DStv says to open My Products, select the package and choose Disconnect. The scheduled change takes effect on the next payment date. Check the date shown before confirming, then keep the confirmation or reference number. Revisit the account around that date to check what was processed. Any question about a final charge belongs with DStv through its official support channels. Mzansi Stream cannot administer that account.

title: DStv en Europe : retrouver un programme par pays
description: En France ou en Allemagne, retrouvez le diffuseur d’un match, d’une série ou d’un journal sud-africain. Vérifiez le direct, le replay et la date.
h1: DStv en Europe : où retrouver son match, sa série ou son journal ?
intro: Une famille sud-africaine installée à Lyon et sa sœur à Berlin peuvent suivre la même finale par deux diffuseurs différents. Pour trouver le bon écran, partez du titre, du pays de visionnage et de la date. DStv précise que son application sud-africaine ne donne pas accès au direct et au rattrapage depuis l’Europe. Le diffuseur local peut néanmoins avoir programmé l’événement que vous cherchez.

sections.h2: Comment retrouver la finale France–Afrique du Sud ?
sections.h3: Deux grilles pour le dimanche 29 novembre 2026
paragraphs: En France, TF1 annonce le coup d’envoi de la finale du Championnat des Nations à 17 h 40, heure de Paris, avec une diffusion sur TF1 et TF1+. À Berlin, la grille allemande de ran annonce également la finale à 17 h 40, avec un direct en ligne sur Joyn. Si vous voyez plusieurs pages portant les noms des deux équipes, cherchez la mention « finale » et la date du 29 novembre. Les équipes se sont également rencontrées plus tôt dans la compétition.

Le match a lieu à Londres. Sur un appareil réglé à Paris ou Berlin, utilisez l’horaire de votre diffuseur local. Enregistrez sa fiche dans vos favoris. Si vous arrivez après le coup de sifflet final, cherchez l’intégrale et vérifiez sa durée. La présence d’un résumé de quelques minutes ne confirme pas la disponibilité du match complet en replay.

sections.h2: Où retrouver un journal sud-africain ?
sections.h3: La source directe pour suivre l’actualité
paragraphs: Pour SABC News, commencez chez SABC+. Sa FAQ inclut SABC News, SABC Lehae, la radio et certaines émissions d’actualité à la demande parmi les services accessibles à l’international. Depuis la France ou l’Allemagne, une personne qui veut les nouvelles en direct peut donc essayer le lecteur officiel. Pour un bulletin manqué, ouvrez la rubrique d’actualité à la demande et cherchez sa date.

sections.h2: Et si vous cherchez une série précise ?
sections.h3: Vérifier l’épisode et la langue avant de payer
paragraphs: Notez le titre original, la saison et le numéro de l’épisode. Sur la fiche du diffuseur ou du service disponible dans votre pays, cherchez ces trois renseignements, la langue audio, les sous-titres et la durée de disponibilité. Une interview de l’acteur ou une bande-annonce officielle peut ressortir en premier dans une recherche. S’il manque la fiche de l’épisode complet pour votre pays, sa disponibilité reste à confirmer. Gardez l’argent de l’abonnement tant que votre question porte sur un seul programme dont vous n’avez trouvé que l’extrait.

title: DStv Australia: Find the Match in Perth or Sydney
description: Find the Australian broadcaster for a South African fixture, convert kick-off to Perth or Sydney time and check live and replay access before paying.
h1: DStv Australia: where to watch a Springboks match in Perth or Sydney
intro: France play South Africa in the 2026 Nations Championship final at 12.40 am in Perth and 3.40 am in Sydney on Monday 30 November. Rugby Australia lists Stan Sport for live and on-demand coverage. If your family in South Africa calls it Sunday’s final, you have found the same match. It is already Monday in both Australian cities when the teams kick off.

sections.h2: What time should you put in your calendar?
sections.h3: Choose your city and include the date
paragraphs: Rugby Australia publishes the fixture list in Australian Eastern Daylight Time. For this final, its 3.40 am entry applies to Sydney. Perth uses Australian Western Standard Time and is three hours behind Sydney on that date, giving a 12.40 am start. Someone in Perth should set the reminder for just after midnight on Sunday night. In Sydney it will be the early hours of Monday.

If your calendar invitation was created by someone in London, open its time-zone field before changing the start time. A calendar that already converted the event into your city’s time should need no further adjustment. Add the competition and the word “Final” to the event name. An earlier France–South Africa meeting also appears among the tournament listings.

sections.h2: Will a South African subscription work in Australia?
sections.h3: Find the Australian broadcaster for the fixture
paragraphs: DStv says its live and Catch Up services are available when travelling in participating African territories and unavailable elsewhere. A paid-up South African account therefore does not give a Sydney household access to this match on DStv Stream. Use the tournament listing from Rugby Australia and follow it to the Australian broadcaster. For this competition, Stan Sport publishes a dedicated Nations Championship page with the fixtures.

Before paying, open the listing on the television or phone you want to use. Check the Australian plan terms and whether the Sport add-on is already on your account. A regular Stan subscription and a subscription with the Sport add-on have different inclusions. A single international rugby tournament also tells you nothing about the broadcaster for a different competition.

sections.h2: Would you rather watch after breakfast?
sections.h3: Identify the full replay before opening the highlights
paragraphs: Stan lists the tournament live and on demand. Choose the entry for the 2026 final and check its running time. Match highlights, interviews and the full match can each have their own tile. If keeping the score a surprise matters, bookmark the tournament page before kick-off, then go straight to the match listing when you wake up. For the next fixture, repeat the broadcaster and local-time checks with that event’s current schedule.
